question: For each instance display name and VM state, considering only instances that are not deleted, that have the system metadata key image_image_type, and that are running on host blaze8-12, return the number of distinct instances and the earliest instance creation time. Do not return any rounded answers.

SELECT
  i.display_name,
  i.vm_state,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS distinct_instance_count,
  MIN(i.created_at) AS earliest_creation_time
FROM instances AS i
JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism
  ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid
WHERE i.deleted = 0
  AND ism.deleted = 0
  AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type'
  AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'
GROUP BY i.display_name, i.vm_state
ORDER BY i.display_name, i.vm_state;
